name: DPW Hall of Fame
epitaph: A single induction, published as its own section of the fed's first roster sheet only weeks after the fed itself opened -- the sheet's own text jokes about the fact ('How can DPW have a Hall of Fame if it's been around only 4 weeks?') before crediting the honoree with keeping alive the history of the CVWF and the operator's earlier WCWF.

bestowals.source: the fed's own 5/4/96 roster sheet, in a dedicated 'DPW Hall of Fame' section
bestowals.vote_detail: the roster sheet's own text: "This entry goes out to... Peace Joel.. We're awaiting your return!" — credited with a two-time WCWF World Tag Team Championship run and a rivalry with Made Out of Steel carried across three federations.
